scope: Opt-in BF16 KV on existing pinned Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Q4-mixed, same immutable weights and FP32 compute. This is a bounded quality screen, not a general quality guarantee. FP32 remains the default.
payload_gate: Every allocated KV and prefix page has exactly half the numeric payload bytes of FP32; planner, admission and telemetry agree. Runtime/weight/RSS memory is not claimed to halve.
default_gate: Default and explicit FP32 logits, KV and IDs match the predecessor bit-for-bit; existing race/lifecycle/prefix/CLI tests pass.

quality.documents: All six evaluation_documents, first up to 48 next-token targets per document, no selection prompts
quality.comparison: Paired teacher-forced contexts, same token IDs; KL(FP32 || BF16) and target NLL for every row. Record all per-row metrics and document means.

long_answers.prefix: Repeat the six evaluation documents in order until at least 384 encoded tokens, keep the first 384, then append each fixed question using the HF tokenizer with post-processing/BOS disabled (encodeText(ctx,text,1024,false)).
long_answers.sampling: Greedy, fixed 128 steps including EOS, context must fit. This bounded continuation probe is not a completed chat-answer claim.
long_answers.comparison: Save both complete token sequences and decoded continuations. Inspect both for new repeated loops, non-finite output or loss of the question's requested facts/language. Any new BF16-only failure holds adoption pending investigation; disagreement alone is reported rather than scored as failure. No regenerated answers or threshold relaxation.

execution: One resident set of immutable weights, separate model views/pools/caches for each format; same process teacher-forced pairs alternate FP32/BF16 order each token. Long-answer formats run FP32 then BF16 for English and reverse for Japanese. Keep all first results. Timing is diagnostic only, no speed claim from this probe.
adoption: All numerical, memory, lifecycle and long-answer screen gates must pass. Otherwise preserve negative evidence and keep the candidate experimental/unadopted. No automatic default-format change.
